text:
Zoe Harper: Heads-up — proposing a console toggle called `surge_visibility` to enable per-route heatmaps during config rollouts. Idea: opt-in at team level, default low sample. Want to surface fanout / cohort spikes during phased rollouts. cc @Samir @Jorge :eyes:
Samir Patel: Why not piggyback on the existing preview/dry-run telemetry? Heatmaps are heavier but they show where traffic fans out across route variants. Baseline + small detailed sample might work.
Jorge Alvarez: Perf flag: collecting detailed histograms per-route at 1s granularity will blow up telemetry QPS. Suggest: two-tier collection — aggregator rollups (default) + a detailed stream for selected cohorts. Also add a backpressure flag so the collector can drop detailed if overloaded.
Mira Chen: From an oncall POV we really only need quick deltas: 95th/99th latency per-route and error-rate delta vs baseline. Heatmaps are helpful for debugging but not for every alert. Could we have console show summarized deltas with an "expand to heatmap" button that triggers detailed sampling?
Kai Nguyen: Implementation sketch: add runtime config schema and API patch, something like:
```json
{
  "surge_visibility": {
    "mode": "baseline", // off | baseline | detailed
    "sample_rate": 0.01, // float 0..1
    "detailed_cohorts": ["canary","beta-users"],
    "retention_days": 7
  }
}
```
Then console UI toggles mode; API stores per-team override. Collector honors sample_rate and cohort whitelist.
Samir Patel: :+1: baseline mode + on-demand detailed expansion sounds good. Default sample_rate 0.01 is reasonable to start. Need to document unit cost impact and show an estimated token/ingest cost in the UI.
Zoe Harper: Security/privacy note — telemetry must not include user-identifying keys. Add a scrub step before heatmap buckets are emitted. Also require opt-in for "detailed" for private deployments.
Jorge Alvarez: Telemetry pipeline change list: aggregation window, retention, cohort labels, backpressure signals. I'll draft the PR for collector + a schema bump for the runtime config.
Mira Chen: Rollout plan idea: 1) config schema + console toggle behind feature flag; 2) enable baseline globally with sample_rate 0.005 for 48h; 3) let teams opt-in to detailed per-cohort; 4) monitor cost/ingest and auto-pause if collector CPU > 70%.
Kai Nguyen: API debate — should this be a new top-level runtime flag or a per-rollout metadata field? If per-rollout, we get tighter scoping but more complexity in console. Leaning per-team top-level with per-rollout override.
Samir Patel: Also add telemetry gating: detailed data only retained for X days and auto-archived. Need a quick way to replay heatmap for incident postmortems.
Zoe Harper: Action items: Jorge to open collector PR + perf estimate, Kai to propose config schema PR, Samir to add UI mock for estimated cost, Mira to draft rollout runbook. I'll follow up with a short RFC after PRs land.
deploy-bot: deploy started: telemetry-collector v2 -> staging (sha: b7f3c2) :rocket:
Zoe Harper: sgtm, thanks everyone.
Samir Patel: happy to pair on the UI cost calc tomorrow.
Jorge Alvarez: will aim to have collector PR by EOD Fri.
Mira Chen: tagging oncall list for runbook review once draft is ready: @oncall
Kai Nguyen: one more note — include an escape hatch: emergency global off switch for `surge_visibility` in case of telemetry storm.
Zoe Harper: agreed, emergency off and a grace cooldown window.
Samir Patel: :thumbsup:
